scope: Read-only code/config review; test JSONL files were not opened or copied.

blocking_findings.issue: Official config disables source-image hash preflight.
Per-image loss is grouped only within each shuffled crop batch. Crops from one parent can be split across batches, so parent images are not guaranteed equal weight over an epoch.
Official output directory is reusable and files are opened with write mode, so an existing run can be overwritten.
No fresh-process official checkpoint reload/metric equivalence gate is executed after training.
blocking_findings.evidence: src/models/b2_classifier.py defines load_checkpoint at line 106, but scripts/train_b2.py never calls it

decision: PENDING TV3 FIX / REVIEW; no B2 official metrics accepted and no B1/B2 winner selected.
